name: Lagos
focus: Compare shade on busy walking routes with canopy in compounds, parks and by the lagoon.

name: Ibadan
focus: Compare shade around markets and schools with canopy in residential streets.

name: Abuja
focus: Compare canopy on planned avenues with shade along pedestrian routes in expanding districts.

name: Jos
focus: Compare mature tree cover across plateau neighbourhoods and the urban fringe.

name: Kano
focus: Identify shade gaps around markets, schools and transport stops, and test how the mapping method detects sparse crowns.

name: Kaduna
focus: Assess the distribution of mature trees along streets and compare it with canopy along waterways.

name: Maiduguri
focus: Test whether historical satellite layers pick up sparse tree cover and identify candidate walking routes for local review.

name: Gombe
focus: Compare canopy visibility between seasons and flag potential shade gaps along public routes.

name: Enugu
focus: Compare canopy across neighbourhood streets and the hills around the city, accounting for terrain shadows.

name: Owerri
focus: Compare canopy in established neighbourhoods with coverage along outward growth corridors.

name: Port Harcourt
focus: Measure urban canopy and nearby mangrove extent separately, and check their boundaries around creeks.

name: Benin City
focus: Identify neighbourhoods where mature trees could be retained as streets and housing expand.
